legacy_tooltipStreamerMode.message: Enables a special set of functions for streamers. If you disable it, everything below will not work.

legacy_obsHelpSwalHtml.message:
You have activated a special section that contains LEGACY features that made video chats more suitable for broadcasting.

Only OBS integration was preserved, every other feature is gone forever.

* integration with obs
— allows you to display geolocation data in the text source.
— allows you to control the visibility of the image, which covers the video while you look for a suitable interlocutor.
— you can activate the cover with the h button on the control panel.

Please note that not all platforms allow users to stream random video chats: for example, youtube is tolerant of this, but the twitch community guidelines explicitly state that "Use randomized video chat services" is forbidden.

legacy_tooltipStreamerBlurCoverSection.message: Enable if you want to hide your stranger's camera feed. You will be able to capture just the browser in OBS, cover the stranger with custom image/gif, and look at him through picture-in-picture mode to decide whether to show him on yout broadcast.

legacy_tooltipObsIntegrationSection.message: enables integration with Open Broadcaster Software (the most popular social media streaming software). It allows the extension to output the location of the interlocutor and control the image that covers his image.

legacy_tooltipObsShowErrorsStatus.message: show errors & status of connection in the left bottom corner.

legacy_tooltipObsControlCover.message: allows the extension to control the visibility of the image that covers the interlocutor. many streamers do this in order to be able to turn off the image of the interlocutor on the live stream at any time. you need to create any source in the OBS named VE_COVER and place it above the image of the interlocutor. Now you can toggle this VE_COVER visibility with one button (h/H) / by pressing a shorcut (h / right arrow) / automatically (configurable at the very bottom)

legacy_tooltipObsControlGeolocation.message: displays the location of the stranger in the text source named VE_TEXT in the active scene. first, of course, you need to create a VE_TEXT text source and style it however you like.

legacy_promptFormatSrc.message:
these special words will be replaced with actual data:

* \n -> break line
* $$status -> json.status (success)
* $$country -> json.country (Australia)
* $$countryCode -> json.countryCode (AU)
* $$region -> json.region (QLD)
* $$regionName -> json.regionName (Queensland)
* $$city -> json.city (South Brisbane)
* $$lat -> json.lat (-27.4766)
* $$lon -> json.lon (153.0166)
* $$timezone -> json.timezone (Australia/Brisbane)
* $$isp -> json.isp (Cloudflare, Inc)
* $$mobile -> json.mobile (false)
* $$proxy -> json.proxy (false)
* $$hosting -> json.hosting (true)

legacy_tooltipBlurOnStart.message: every new conversation will start blurred / covered. remember: you need to enable BLUR / COVER or OBS INTEGRATION first.

legacy_tooltipCoverOverPreview.message: enable this if you want to auto-enable blur/cover at 'preview' stage

legacy_tooltipCoverOverNoise.message: enable this if you want to auto-enable blur/cover at 'search' stage

legacy_tooltipCoverOverStop.message: enable this if you want to auto-enable blur/cover at 'stop' stage

legacy_tooltipUncoverOnPlay.message: enable this if you want to use the cover only as a replacement for the search noise

legacy_mapProviderTooltip.message: select the map provider to use

legacy_mapProviderVariantTooltip.message: select the map style variant to use

legacy_showRandomMapButtonTooltip.message: show/hide the random map style button (dice icon) on the map

legacy_resetMapStyleTooltip.message: reset the map style to default

legacy_showMapAttributionTooltip.message: show/hide the map attribution control at the bottom of the map

legacy_tooltipApiLocalisation.message: Turn this on to request localized data. Available languages: English, German, Spanish, Portuguese, French, Japanese, Chinese, Russian.

legacy_tooltipIpApiPreferredLang.message: Select your preferred language for geolocation data. If there is no translation, data will be in English.

legacy_tooltipHideMobile.message: Turn this on so that the city and region will be hidden if the interlocutor has mobile internet. Almost always these data are not correct.

legacy_tooltipShowCT.message: Turn this on so that the city and region will be displayed in the 'CT' section if the interlocutor has mobile internet.

legacy_tooltipShowMoreInfo.message: Enable this to display additional information about the IP address. Mobile - mobile (cellular) connection. Hosting -  proxy, VPN or Tor exit address. Hosting - hosting, colocated or data center.

legacy_tooltipShowISP.message: Enable this to show ISP (Internet Service Provider) data if available.

legacy_tooltipAutoOpenPopup.message: If enabled, in the 'map' section, a window with information about the location will open automatically. If disabled, you can still open it manually.

legacy_tooltipAutoFitBounds.message: If enabled, the map will change its scale to fit the estimated area of the interlocutor.

legacy_tooltipAutoSetView.message: If enabled, the map will set its center to the stranger's approximate coordinates.

legacy_tooltipShowUSStatesBorders.message: If enabled, US state border lines will be displayed on the map for better geographical reference.

legacy_tooltipShowHints.message: if enabled, will show a random 'Did you know?' message every time you open a video chat

legacy_tooltipshowHintsMoreOften.message: if enabled, hints will show every time you open a video chat. if disabled, there is only a 20% chance of appearing
